title: docs.issue-draft.failed.v1
description: Docs couldn't draft a GitHub issue from a study note, answering flow.issue-draft.requested.v1. The message is short and never carries the note's text, a token or a stack trace. requestId is the id of the request event answered, so Flow can drop a late answer to an earlier attempt.

stepId.description: The run's step that waits for the answer (from the request)

requestId.description: The id of the flow.issue-draft.requested.v1 event this answers

code.description: Why: no such note of the subject, the subject lacks docs.read or docs.issues.create, the note already has an issue, the target repository can't be reached, the AI's answer wasn't a usable issue, or the AI isn't answering
